location: Riverside Plaza parking lot, 220 Riverside Drive, Tampa, FL
narrative: While I was pulling out of a parking space at {location}, a vehicle reversing from the next row hit my driver-side rear door and quarter panel. Nobody was hurt. The other driver gave me her insurance information and the store's security camera covers that row of the lot. I obtained a written estimate from the body shop.
